pages.text: The Omnipotence Core can make anything - except what lies beyond Omnipotence. To go further it must be given up.$(br2)Its screen has a $(thing)Shutdown Sequence$(). Begun, it cannot be stopped: in sixty seconds the Core releases every law it holds, and the Transcendental comes apart from the rim inwards.

Anyone still there is carried out at the end. Afterwards nobody can enter the Transcendental at all.$(br2)Whoever began the sequence receives what is left: $(item)Shards of Omnipotence$() and the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(). Everyone learns $(thing)The Sundering$().
This is not the end of the road: see $(l:endgame/beyond_the_shutdown)Beyond the Shutdown$() for where it leads - the Rekindling, the Forge and the last things.
